audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Gangplank levels 3-5 and First item while the same whys describe Cho'Gath stabilising there; it also contradicts a 54.63% Cho'Gath win rate over 626 games.
audit.why: Gangplank's edge is levels 1-2 barrel-and-Parrrley poke (Parrrley 4.5s, 625 range). From 3 Feral Scream is online and Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1, so Cho'Gath owns 3 through first item. Only the two-item global/kite game is Gangplank's.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Gangplank / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Gangplank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named no cooldowns; the level-6 why said only that 'Gangplank's ultimate changes the math'.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s, true damage, permanent max HP. Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the reason the side lane opens after he burns it. Heartsteel plus one Feast stack is the all-in timing.
audit.corrected: Named Feast 80s and Cannon Barrage 160s in the level-6 phase, and keyed the first-item spike to Remove Scurvy's 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every interaction line tracked 'Powder Kegs' as if it were a cooldown to bait. Powder Keg has no cooldown in Riot's data — it is charge-based — and the decisive interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Feral Scream (W, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) silences. Remove Scurvy (W, 22/20/18/16/14s) is his only cleanse and his only heal, and a silenced Gangplank cannot cast it. Silencing BEFORE he cleanses means Rupture's slow sticks and he has no dash to leave; Rupture (Q, flat 6s, 950 range) also pops him airborne.
audit.corrected: Lead with Feral Scream, not Rupture: silenced, he cannot eat Remove Scurvy, so the knockup and slow both stick. Track Remove Scurvy's 22s, not barrels.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage only on Powder Kegs's cooldown' pointed at the wrong button.
audit.why: Powder Keg is charge-based (cooldown 0 in Riot data); Remove Scurvy at 22s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown in this lane.
audit.corrected: Focus target moved to Gangplank Remove Scurvy (W).

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are weak at 1: Parrrley (4.5s, 625 range) out-ranges you, but Carnivore keeps you even. Farm the casters and commit to nothing.

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: His level-2 barrel-and-Parrrley chain out-trades you before Feral Scream is up — soak the wave, do not walk.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Feral Scream is online: silence him and Remove Scurvy (22s) cannot be cast at all, so Rupture's slow sticks and you win the walk-up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Barrels are charge-based, so the real window is Remove Scurvy: 22 seconds down at rank 1 is your free all-in. Freeze and make him walk.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast (80s) is permanent max HP plus a true-damage execute that ignores his crit bulk. Cannon Barrage is 160s at rank 1 — once he burns it the side lane is yours.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Heartsteel plus a Feast stack: force the all-in the moment Remove Scurvy goes on its 22s.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — Q-W + R him.
edits.after: Feral Scream first: silenced, he cannot eat Remove Scurvy, so Rupture's slow sticks — then Feast.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gangplank Remove Scurvy: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and he cannot cast it while Feral Scream silences him. Barrels have charges, not a cooldown. - Feast: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Feast's true damage executes through his crit and Trinity HP — bait Remove Scurvy, then Rupture-knockup into Feral Scream silences him off his barrels.
edits.after: Feast's true damage executes through his crit and Trinity HP — open Feral Scream so he cannot eat Remove Scurvy, then Rupture-knockup and he is stuck.

edits.before: His Remove Scurvy is on cooldown after a cleanse — knock him up, silence him, and he has no dash to reposition out of your follow-up.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy is down 22 seconds at rank 1 after a cleanse — knock him up, silence him, and he has no dash to reposition out of it.

edits.before: This is where the lane swings to you. By 4-5 your sustain, waveclear and Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize the poke, and at 6 Feast changes everything — its true damage ignores his crit-built bulk and Trinity/Steraks HP and threatens a kill if he ever steps up for a melee trade. Bait out Remove Scurvy first, then Rupture to knock him up and chain Feral Scream; the silence stops him detonating barrels, and his W can clear the stun but not the displacement since he has no dash. Without barrels up, his Parrrley alone can't beat your healing — punish him every time Remove Scurvy is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is where the lane swings to you. By 4-5 your sustain, waveclear and Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize the poke, and at 6 Feast changes everything — its true damage ignores his crit-built bulk and Trinity/Steraks HP and threatens a kill if he ever steps up for a melee trade. Lead with Feral Scream, not Rupture: while he is silenced he cannot eat Remove Scurvy at all, so the knockup and the slow both stick and he has no dash to leave your follow-up. If he does burn the cleanse first, that is 22 seconds at rank 1 with no answer to your combo — punish every single one of them.

notes: Cho'Gath kit file flags Rupture (Q) as 'grounding'; Riot's own description says it pops enemies into the air, so it is a knockup/airborne, not a ground. Wrote it as a knockup. Packet flagged whys[5] 'His Remove Scurvy' as a probable wrong name — false positive, that is the real ability name. Powder Keg has cooldown 0 in Riot data (charge-based); all 'track Powder Kegs cooldown' phrasing in this entry is structurally wrong and I repointed the focus/cooldown fields at Remove Scurvy.
